scope.title: Floor 1 top-down semantic layer studies
scope.sourceSetCamera: Root-approved direct-overhead/top-down scene compositions; thin wall edges, prop depth and stylized readable details may remain. Not mathematically camera-verified.
scope.sourceBoundary: Use only approved top-down source panels and their source sheets. Do not use the earlier mixed-camera source art in this kit.
scope.artBoundary: Semantic layers and reconstructions are illustrative references, not canonical floorplans, tile-ready assets, or runtime maps. Hidden surfaces created beneath occlusion are interpolated/synthesized and cannot recover true source art that was never visible.
scope.status: reviewable-reference-layer-kit; 36 scenes imported; asset and browser HTTP QA passed

globalChecklist.sourceArt: all 36 approved top-down source panels retained with hashes; earlier mixed-camera art excluded
globalChecklist.exactDecomposition: 506 exact-visible-source components across 36 scenes; central output manifest reports 0 changed source pixels for each exact reconstruction. This validates pixel recomposition, not semantic component quality.
globalChecklist.reusableComposition: 524 reusable-mode components across 36 scenes; inferred/generated or source-derived with per-asset provenance. Composition remains interpretive and has no source-pixel fidelity metric.
globalChecklist.hiddenSurfaceInterpolation: inferred surfaces remain synthetic; they do not recover unseen source artwork. Fine-grained hidden props, background context, and lighting are incomplete.
globalChecklist.referenceReconstruction: exact-source and inferred reusable reconstructions are separately available for review
globalChecklist.viewer: Web/wwwroot/top-down-layers.html passed HTTP QA across 36 scenes, all four compare views, slider, source/component links, JSON/native PNG downloads, and mobile 390px without overflow; no JS/HTTP errors.
globalChecklist.visualLimit: reviewable reference layer kit; not production-ready, tile-ready, canonical map data, or gameplay integration
globalChecklist.semanticInventory: Central inventory records 119 exact category layers, 35 materials, and 33 reusable library modules; these counts do not imply exhaustive fine-grained decomposition or production readiness.
globalChecklist.assetTests: Six independent asset tests pass across all 36 scenes.

pilotScenes.status: included in full 36-scene reviewable kit; clean plate and detailed components retain stated limitations

scope.description: Reviewable semantic layer kit for all 36 root-approved top-down Floor 1 source concepts. Exact-source decomposition and inferred reusable alternatives are separate modes. This is a reference workbench, not production-ready or runtime content.

groupRollup.notes: Terrain patches in scenes 25–29 remain labeled as patches. Other Crawlers’ Guild retains explicit component/clean-plate limitations.

componentTotals.note: Counts are per-mode component records; the same visible object may appear in both modes and counts twice. Category layers/materials/modules are separate catalog counts.

reconstructionContract.target: restore extracted visible components over an interpolated hidden-surface underlay for reference comparison
reconstructionContract.plannedInvariant: pixels outside the union of component masks must match the source; inpainting is confined to the union of masks; restored visible pixels are compared against the original source
reconstructionContract.limitation: The synthesized underlay does not reveal, recover, or assert what was behind an occluder in the original scene.

viewer.status: HTTP QA passed across 36 scenes; six independent asset tests pass
